whatIs.question: What is MySchool?
whatIs.answer: MySchool is a multi-tenant school management platform that brings admissions, students, academics, attendance and assessment, fees and accounting, HR, educational supervision, communication, and portals into one system.

whoFor.question: Who is MySchool for?
whoFor.answer: It is built for schools and the people who run them: school management, teachers, educational supervisors, finance teams, HR staff, students, and guardians — each with an experience suited to their role.

locales.question: Does MySchool support Arabic and English?
locales.answer: Yes. MySchool supports Arabic and English interfaces so school teams can work in the language that fits their context.

tryBeforeContact.question: Can I try MySchool before contacting you?
tryBeforeContact.answer: Yes. When the public demo environment is configured, you can open it directly from this website. You do not need to submit a contact form first.

demoFree.question: Is the public demo free to access?
demoFree.answer: Yes. The public demo is free to explore when it is available. This means access to the demo environment — not a free production subscription.

demoAccount.question: Do I need an account to explore the demo?
demoAccount.answer: You do not need to create a personal production school account. The demo login page provides exploration access and available demo role experiences when the environment is ready.

demoNotProduction.question: Is the public demo the same as a production school account?
demoNotProduction.answer: No. The public demo is for exploration. It is not your school’s production environment and should not be treated as live operational data for a real school.

students.question: Does MySchool include student management?
students.answer: Yes. MySchool includes admissions, student records, and guardian relationships as part of its student and family capabilities.

attendance.question: Does MySchool include attendance?
attendance.answer: Yes. Attendance is part of the academic and classroom workflows supported by the platform.

finance.question: Does the system include accounting and fees?
finance.answer: Yes. The platform includes fee collection, student accounts, expenses, and accounting capabilities such as payroll-related accounting workflows.

hr.question: Does it include HR and payroll?
hr.answer: Yes. HR capabilities include employee records, attendance, leave, and related staffing workflows, with accounting capabilities connected to payroll.

supervision.question: Does MySchool include educational supervision?
supervision.answer: Yes. Educational supervisors have a dedicated experience for evaluations, classroom visits, and teacher follow-up.

studentPortal.question: Is there a student portal?
studentPortal.answer: Yes. Students have a dedicated portal for areas such as schedule, homework, grades, and attendance — separate from staff workspaces.

guardianPortal.question: Is there a guardian portal?
guardianPortal.answer: Yes. Guardians have a dedicated portal to follow academics, finance-related information, and school communication according to granted access.

separated.question: Are student, teacher, guardian, and staff experiences separated?
separated.answer: Yes. Roles use different workspaces and portals. Staff tools are not the same interface as student or guardian portals.

permissions.question: How do permissions work?
permissions.answer: MySchool uses role- and page-based permissions. School administration controls what each role can view or manage, so access follows responsibility.

branches.question: Can MySchool be used across more than one branch?
branches.answer: Yes, where needed. The platform includes branch management so schools can organize multi-branch operations within the same system.

deployment.question: How is MySchool deployed or set up?
deployment.answer: Deployment and onboarding details depend on the commercial arrangement for your school. This site does not publish a fixed cloud/on-premises checklist or SLA. Contact us to discuss setup needs.

contact.question: How do I contact you?
contact.answer: Use the Contact page for general questions, starting the free first year, commercial or deployment needs, or product questions. Exploring the public demo does not require contacting us first.

isFree.question: Is MySchool free?
isFree.answer: The public demo is free to explore. You can use MySchool in your school during the first year without a subscription fee. Continued use after the first year is arranged commercially to fit the school’s needs.

payBeforeDemo.question: Do I need to pay before trying the system?
payBeforeDemo.answer: No. The public demo can be opened directly when it is available — without a contact form or payment.

firstYearFees.question: Are there fees during the first year?
firstYearFees.answer: There is no subscription fee during the first year of real school use.

demoVsFirstYear.question: What is the difference between the public demo and the free first year?
demoVsFirstYear.answer: The public demo is for exploration and getting familiar with the product. The free first year is for adopting MySchool in your school for day-to-day work.

afterFirstYear.question: What happens after the first year ends?
afterFirstYear.answer: After the first year, you can continue using MySchool under a commercial arrangement that fits your school, with ongoing product development and follow-up on issues and feedback.

howSubscription.question: How is the subscription determined after the first year?
howSubscription.answer: We discuss your school’s needs — such as size, branches, scope of use, and required capabilities — then arrange terms that fit that context.

tryBeforeSchool.question: Can I try the system before deciding to use it in my school?
tryBeforeSchool.answer: Yes. You can explore the public demo first, then contact us if you want to start the free first year for your school.

portals.question: Is there a student and guardian portal?
portals.answer: Yes. Students have a dedicated portal for academic areas such as schedule, homework, grades, and attendance. Guardians have a portal to follow academics, finance-related information, and school communication according to granted access.

problemSupport.question: What if we face a problem while using the system?
problemSupport.answer: When an issue appears during use, we follow up with you to understand the cause and work on addressing it.

featureRequests.question: Can we suggest a new feature?
featureRequests.answer: Yes. Schools can send feedback, suggestions, and feature requests. We review them as part of MySchool’s product development priorities. That does not mean every request will be built.

howStartFirstYear.question: How do we start the free first year?
howStartFirstYear.answer: Contact us through the Contact page with basic information about your school so we can begin the adoption and setup discussion.
